svg.title: ManuScript Studio – Navigation Menus & Dropdowns
svg.desc: Annotated breakdown of all navigation menus and dropdowns: Main App AccountMenu (Studio header + 6 items), Customer Portal account dropdown (5 items + logout), Editor left icon rail (9 tabs), Editor snap/grid dropdown, Editor download menu, and a full left-panel expanded view.
svg.text: MANUSCRIPT STUDIO — NAVIGATION MENUS & DROPDOWNS (1440 × 1100px wireframe)
All menus drawn at actual relative sizes · Not all menus appear simultaneously in production
Avatar size: 24px circle · Amber initial letter
5 items + divider + Logout · no icons in portal
Clicking outside closes: document click listener
Active: 3px amber left-edge bar + amber bg tint
Setting pinned to bottom with border-top divider
Toolbar · 3rd button group · w=38px trigger + chevron
Toolbar far-right · amber filled button + chevron
UI labels: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif · Panel section headers: Space Grotesk, 9px, uppercase, tracking-widest
Annotations (this diagram): Courier New, monospace · Body: 11–13px · Heading: 16–26px
Dropdowns: Radix UI DropdownMenu (AccountMenu) · Native state toggle (portal account dropdown)
Left panel: custom ResizablePanel with drag handle · Right panel: 260–560px resizable when Settings → resizable panels enabled
Toolbar: flex row with gap-1 groups separated by 1px #2a2d38 dividers · Snap/Grid dropdown: Radix DropdownMenu · Export: Radix DropdownMenu
③④ Left rail + panels → client/src/Editor.tsx (LEFT_ICON_SIDEBAR_WIDTH=52, DEFAULT_LEFT_PANEL_WIDTH=256)
⑥ Export menu → client/src/components/ExportDialog.tsx + toolbar download button
